description: Reconstruct historical position snapshots from ledger and marks
steps: Accept inputs: wallet address, start_date, end_date
Check which day partitions already exist in S3 Gold for wallet_position_snapshot_daily
For missing partitions, reconstruct from wallet_position_ledger: replay fills chronologically to rebuild position state at each day boundary
Join reconstructed positions with market_mark_daily to compute mark_price, position_value_usd, unrealized_pnl_usd
Handle edge cases: no trades in range (carry forward last known position), market with no mark (skip or use last available)

description: Cache computed snapshots to S3 Gold and optionally ClickHouse
steps: Always write computed missing partitions to S3 Gold (wallet_position_snapshot_daily)
If partition date is within last 90 days, also load into ClickHouse
Use idempotent partition overwrite for S3 writes
Log summary: partitions computed, partitions cached, rows written

description: CLI command for on-demand snapshot computation
steps: Implement `prediction-data gold compute-snapshot --wallet ADDR --start-date YYYY-MM-DD --end-date YYYY-MM-DD`
Add --dry-run flag (report what would be computed without writing)
Add --skip-ch flag (write to S3 only, skip ClickHouse loading)
Chunk large date ranges into manageable batches (e.g., 30-day chunks)
Print progress: 'Computing snapshots for wallet 0xABC... day 15/365'
Write unit test: wallet with known trade history → verify reconstructed snapshots match expected daily positions
Write unit test: partial existing snapshots → only missing days computed
Write unit test: wallet with no trades in requested range → carry forward last position
Write integration test: end-to-end CLI invocation with mock Silver data
